hero.title: Is Claude Code safe for proprietary code
hero.subtitle: Everything you need to know about security, compliance, and how Claude Code handles your codebase.
tab-1.label: Overview
tab-1.body: Claude Code is Anthropic's agentic coding assistant that works directly in your codebase across terminal, IDE, web, mobile, Slack, and GitHub. It runs locally and talks directly to model APIs without a remote code index.
tab-2.label: How it works
tab-2.body: Claude Code reads, writes, and executes code, runs tasks across parallel subagents, and opens pull requests end-to-end. Routines let it run scheduled or event-triggered tasks with no manual trigger required.
tab-3.label: Security
tab-3.body: Claude Code for Enterprise is SOC 2 Type II compliant, encrypts data with TLS 1.3 in transit and AES-256 at rest, and does not train on Enterprise customer data. Bring-your-own-key deployment keeps code within your own VPC.
facts.title: At a glance

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq-1.question: Is Claude Code safe to use with proprietary code?
faq-1.answer: Claude Code for Enterprise is SOC 2 Type II compliant, encrypts data with TLS 1.3 in transit and AES-256 at rest, and does not train on Enterprise customer data.
faq-2.question: What are the system requirements for Claude Code?
faq-2.answer: Claude Code runs on macOS, Linux, and Windows, working locally in your terminal without requiring a backend server or remote code index.
faq-3.question: How much does Claude Code cost?
faq-3.answer: Claude Code is included with the Pro plan ($17/month annual or $20/month), Max plans (from $100/month), and Team/Enterprise plans.
faq-4.question: What's the difference between Claude and Claude Code?
faq-4.answer: Claude is the general conversational assistant. Claude Code is a specialized agentic tool for software engineering that works directly in your codebase.
